name: Svasara Jungle Lodge Restaurant
signature_dish: Wildlife-camp set lunch with local Vidarbha sides
why_it_matters: Svasara is a Relais & Chateaux-grade jungle lodge 300m from Kolara Gate — the lodge dining hall opens to non-residents by prior reservation, with a daily-set Vidarbha-leaning menu (Saoji is the Nagpur-region spicy mutton/chicken signature). The deepest food experience for travellers staying at budget lodges who want one upscale meal during their Tadoba visit.
insider_tip: Walk-in dining not accepted — call 24 hours ahead. Lunch is set-menu (₹1500-2000), dinner à la carte (₹2000+). Useful as a paired evening after a 6am safari with a non-Svasara lodge.
signature_address: Kolara Gate, Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve, Chandrapur 442401

name: The Bamboo Forest Safari Lodge Restaurant
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of 1 hotel in Masal village with 501 Tripadvisor reviews and a 4.0 rating — luxurious private villas facing Lake Maasal with a dining hall open to non-residents by reservation. Bonfire BBQ in the dry months (Oct-May) is the signature group-evening order. State-of-the-art safari vehicles park on the lodge grounds.
insider_tip: Bonfire BBQ buffet is Saturday-night only, ₹2500/head — book 48 hours ahead. Weekday lunches more reliable for walk-ins on the lodge's confirmation.
signature_address: Masal village, Kolara Gate, Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve, Chandrapur 442401

name: Irai Safari Retreat Restaurant
signature_dish: Lake-view buffet with local Vidarbha sides
why_it_matters: Buffer-zone lodge with an open lake-side dining area — barbeques + bonfires + Irish bar. Reliable mid-tier dining option near Moharli Gate (the highest-tiger-sighting zone). Multi-cuisine buffet covers Indian + Chinese + Continental. À la carte 6-10pm. Easier walk-in policy than Svasara or Bamboo Forest.
insider_tip: Lake-side terrace tables open at sunset 5:30pm — book ahead in winter (Nov-Feb) for the bonfire-BBQ combination. Buffet lunch (₹700) is the value order between safaris.
signature_address: Moharli Gate, Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve, Chandrapur 442401

name: Tigress @ Ghosri Lodge Restaurant
why_it_matters: Sophisticated forest retreat with panoramic Ghosri Hills views — fine dining set-menus serving Vidarbha and pan-Indian preparations. Smaller, quieter scene than the Kolara-side lodges. Useful for evening dining after Junona/Ghosri afternoon safari.
insider_tip: Non-residents require 24-hour pre-booking; set-menu only at lunch + dinner. The hill-view sunset table books out by Friday for weekend dinners — call ahead. ₹2000+ per head.
